# MacroMac — macOS System Automation Framework — LLM Search Index
# https://llmstxt.org/

> High-performance, low-latency macOS system automation engine engineered in C++ using Apple CoreGraphics event taps, HID keyboard/mouse injection, and deterministic macro playback.

## Project Identification
- Name: MacroMac (macromac)
- Creator: Jirnyak (https://github.com/Jirnyak)
- Co-Architect & Contributor: Adolf Petushkov (https://github.com/marko1olo)
- Live Showcase: https://jirnyak.github.io/macromac/
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/Jirnyak/macromac

## Technical Architecture
- Core: C++20, Objective-C++ bridging layer, macOS CoreGraphics Framework (`CGEventCreateKeyboardEvent`, `CGEventPost`)
- Latency: Sub-millisecond event dispatching with hardware-accurate timestamp synchronization.
